reason: Nurix Therapeutics (nurixtx.com, Brisbane CA) is a publicly traded clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company doing targeted protein degradation drug discovery with a global Roche co-development deal — the wrong vertical and wrong side of the market entirely for David Shake, whose niche is $2M-$20M low-voltage systems integrators, electrical contractors, and property-technology vendors adding a new technology line to buildings they already serve; the three matched postings (Sr. Director Head of Regulatory & Medical Writing, Director Regulatory Affairs, Senior Director Regulatory Affairs Hematology Oncology) are pharma regulatory-submission roles with zero relation to managed Wi-Fi, surveillance, access control, estimating, or recurring service-plan revenue, and the one adjacent title in the fresh feed (Director, IT Infrastructure & Operations) is internal corporate IT at a public biotech, not an integrator building a new technology division, so no quotable line redescribes the pain this CTO fixes and the company is far too large and too well-capitalized for a fractional engagement of this type.
